svg.title: A shop on one cloud region
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 6 components and 5 connections in 1 boundary. Cloud region eu-central-1: Shop API, Orders, Order events. Main path: Customer → Web shop → Shop API → Order events → Payment provider. Most connected: Shop API (3 connections). Nothing leads into Customer. Nothing leads out of Orders and Payment provider. Bottleneck: Shop API; without it the diagram falls apart. Customer (person): connects to Web shop (browses). Web shop (frontend): connects to Shop API (calls, via HTTPS/JSON). Shop API (service): connects to Orders (reads, writes, via SQL/TLS) and Order events (publishes, via AMQP). Orders (database): no outgoing connection. Order events (queue): connects to Payment provider (charges, via HTTPS). Payment provider (external system): no outgoing connection.
svg.text: A shop on one cloud region
